projects.title: Control Plus
projects.shortDescription: Comprehensive access control system using QR codes for residential complexes
projects.fullDescription: ControlPlus is a comprehensive access control system designed for residential complexes, buildings and spaces that require entry management through QR codes. The application allows registering different types of users (residents, visitors, employees and administrators), each with specific permission levels that determine which doors or areas they can access. The system implements a secure registration flow with email verification, automatic generation of unique QR codes for each user, and real-time access validation. Users receive their QR code by email after verifying their account, and can use it by scanning it from a file or entering the token directly. The project architecture is completely separated between frontend and backend, following good development practices and clean architecture, which facilitates maintenance, scalability and future system expansions.

projects.title: Fitness Tracker
projects.shortDescription: Web application for tracking physical activities with interactive maps and real-time analysis
projects.fullDescription: Fitness Tracker is a professional web application for real-time physical activity tracking that allows recording, monitoring and analyzing running, cycling and walking workouts. It integrates interactive maps with OpenStreetMap and Leaflet for route visualization, includes automatic route planning using OSRM from current location, and offers continuous GPS tracking with real-time metrics calculation (distance, speed, calories, pace). Features a daily statistics dashboard, activity export in standard GPX format, local data persistence with Zustand and localStorage, and a mobile-first responsive design with complete dark mode. The application uses Next.js 16 with App Router, React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, offering a professional user experience with smooth animations through Framer Motion and elegant toast notifications.

projects.title: MP3 Player Web
projects.shortDescription: Modern web music player application with playlist management
projects.fullDescription: MP3 Player Web is a modern web application that allows you to manage and play your music library intuitively. Features song downloads from YouTube with automatic MP3 conversion (in local mode), complete custom playlist system with shuffle function and drag-and-drop reordering. The player includes complete controls, interactive progress bar, volume control and continuous playback with automatic song transitions. All music is stored in the cloud for global access. The application operates in two modes: development with all features enabled, and demo with 25 pre-loaded songs.

projects.title: ClimaGlobal
projects.fullDescription: ClimaGlobal is a weather web application developed with Angular 19 that allows real-time weather queries for over 200,000 cities around the world. It stands out for its professional architecture implementing 9 classic design patterns and efficient data structures. Includes a unique dynamic SVG animation system that generates up to 350 particles in real time with ultra-realistic rain, snow and storm effects at constant 60 FPS. Features intelligent cache that reduces HTTP requests by 60%, 100% strong typing with TypeScript, and modern visual design with glassmorphism, vibrant gradients and over 30 fluid microinteractions. The application implements OnPush Change Detection, Lazy Loading and GPU-accelerated animations for optimal performance.
